pattern.summary: Bash commands fail with "No such file or directory" on paths the agent assumed existed

evidence.excerpt:
cd packages/api && npm test
bash: cd: packages/api: No such file or directory

rule.title: Verify a path exists before cd-ing into it
rule.snippet: Before `cd <dir>` or running a command in a subdir, confirm the directory exists (e.g. `ls <dir>`); don't assume a path from memory.
rule.rationale: Bash steps repeatedly fail with ENOENT on directories the agent assumed were present, costing a retry loop.
